<script>

    function mergeUrls(url1, url2) {
        try {
            const baseUrl = url1.split("?")[0];
            const baseParams = new URLSearchParams(url1.split("?")[1] || "");
            const overrideParams = new URLSearchParams(url2.split("?")[1] || "");

            overrideParams.forEach((value, key) => {
                baseParams.set(key, value);
            });

            return (baseUrl + (
                baseParams.toString()
                    ? "?" + baseParams.toString()
                    : ""
            ));
        } catch  {
            return url1;
        }
    }

    async function stickyDot() {

        try {
          //debugger
            Flickerlessly.onReady({
                selector: '#DOT a',
                persist: true,
                success: function(){
                    const dotLink = $("#DOT a").first();
                    if (!dotLink.length) 
                        return;
                    
                    const url1 = window.location.href;
                    const url2 = dotLink.attr("href");
                    if (!url2) 
                        return;
                    
                    const mergedUrl = mergeUrls(url1, url2);
                    $("#DOT a").attr("href", mergedUrl);
                }
            });

        } catch (e) {}
    }
    stickyDot();

</script>
